text_block_list.text: Heading to trainer's office, heard lively voices from gymnasium and investigated—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nice shoot!
Let's get one more!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Their point guard is moving! Going in for mark!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Basketball tournament finals... defending champions Team "Takex" advanced without issue desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wonder how far Ryan's team, "Norry's", can hold out against them...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haaah... breath-taking! Thrilling desu wa! Heart-pounding desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hey now, calm down. Mejiro family carries elegance... right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Even so...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa!
Ryan-senpai, nice steal!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, so cool!
Do your best--!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Incredible cheers... Ryan is super popular as always.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We cannot lose to them desu wa!
Ryan, shoot, dunk it desu wa-!
Match progressed, reaching final moments right before buzzer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Free throw. If Ryan makes this, comeback victory...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Uuu... nerve-racking just watching desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Ryan-senpai, you got this--!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Senpai, sink it in--!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...We want to cheer too, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: In this situation, might only add pressure...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank you, everyone...!
And then—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa!!
Senpai, nice shot!!

text_block_list.name: Referee Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Game set!
Winners of the basketball tournament, "The Nories"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh... All rightttt!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Um... everyone!
Thank you so much for cheering for me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Knowing you're supporting the "me right now"
gave me strength to push through!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
From now on,
I'll keep working hard in my own way!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: You were super, super cool!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
We'll keep rooting for our cool, hardworking,
hard-charging senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Turning cheers to your side in that spot...
You really are cool, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, indeed, desu wa.
